headline: Zoning ordinance amendment to align with state law on protected accessory dwelling units.
summary: The committee will take up a Mayor's request to amend Somerville's zoning ordinance on protected accessory dwelling units. A zoning item from Councilor Link is listed to be withdrawn.
items: Mayor's request to amend Sections 3.1.3, 3.1.6, 3.1.8, 3.1.9, 3.1.11, 3.1.12, 3.1.13, 3.1.16, and 3.2.6 of the Somerville Zoning Ordinance to align with state law on protected accessory dwelling units (ID # 26-1336)
Zoning ordinance amendment to Section 3.1.7.c, referred by Councilor Link, to be withdrawn (ID # 26-1373)
